create_ndstack_rnn_core: create a non-deterministic stack RNN core with configurable stack symbols, states, and size
build_ndstack_initial_state: build the initial state of a non-deterministic stack RNN with empty transition matrices
run_ndstack_rnn_step: run a single step of the non-deterministic stack RNN core with push, pop, and replace actions
update_ndstack_stack: update the non-deterministic stack graph with push, pop, and replace action tensors at a given timestep
read_ndstack_top: read the top of the non-deterministic stack as a normalized probability distribution over symbols
